description: Find the wallets a token's creator is linked to by money (a Solana token, or a Robinhood Chain or BNB Chain one with chain): wallets it funded, wallets that paid it, wallets with the same funder, among the token's earliest buyers, the wallets handed tokens at launch and its largest holders. Says how much of the supply they bought and hold, with the transactions that link them, and why none were found when none were. Costs 2 credits, or without an API key $0.10 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Can take up to two minutes. Results are leads, not proof.

chain.description: robinhood for a Robinhood Chain token (Pons launches), bsc for a BNB Chain one (Flap and four.meme launches).

limit.description: How many candidate wallets to check (early buyers and top holders). Fewer is faster.

mint.description: The token's address: a Solana mint (base58), or a 0x token with chain.

name: find_token_insiders
title: Find a token's insiders
